metadata.name: Uno-Class Bipolar Stepper Driver Motion Model

components.value: Program Stepper; Step D3; DirectionPin D2; Steps 200; Direction CW; StepRate 200

nonPhysicalItems.reason: Shared return net for the board and supply.

physicalNotes: Install U1 with pin 1 at F10. Orient U2 so EN is at D2 and VMOT is at G2. Check the Pololu markings before applying either supply.
Keep the 5 V and 12 V positive rails separate and share the return. Fit C3 with + at BP5 and - at BM8. Power down both supplies before plugging into the motor connector.

nonPhysicalItems.reason: External stimulus or supply connects through J1.
External stimulus or supply connects through J2.
Shared return net for the board and supply.

pcbFabrication.fabricationNotes: J1 takes regulated 5 V logic. J2 takes regulated 12 V motor power. Observe C3 polarity and U2 orientation. J3 connects the two coils of the Pololu 1204 motor.
